request.state:
PATIENT MEDICATION GUIDANCE — TACROVEX (FICTIONAL IMMUNOSUPPRESSANT), TWICE-DAILY DOSING — EXTRACT, AND TRAVEL DIARY

Dosing rule: Take one dose every 12 hours. A dose counts as "on schedule" if it is taken no earlier than 11 hours and no later than 13 hours after the previous dose, measured in actual elapsed time. When travelling across time zones, do not simply follow the clock of your destination; calculate elapsed time.
If a dose is outside the window, contact the transplant clinic's 24-hour line for advice before the following dose.

Time zones for this trip: Chicago on 3 September 2026: UTC−5 (CDT). Madrid on 3–4 September 2026: UTC+2 (CEST).

Patient travel diary (R. Castellano-Wu):
- 3 Sep, 13:00 Chicago time: took dose (lunch, at home).
- 3 Sep, 17:30 Chicago time: flight departed O'Hare for Madrid.
- On boarding I set my watch to Madrid time.
- 4 Sep, 01:30 by my watch (Madrid time), on the plane: took the next dose. "That's 12 and a half hours after my lunchtime dose — within the window."
- 4 Sep, 08:55 Madrid time: landed Madrid.
- 4 Sep, 13:30 Madrid time: took dose at hotel.
Other notes: seat 32C; meal service at 19:00 Chicago time.
Clinic information sheet (extract): "Missing a dose or taking two doses too close together can change blood levels. Keep a written log of dose times in one time zone (for example your home time zone) while travelling."

decision.instructions: Was the dose taken on board (01:30 Madrid time on 4 September) on schedule according to the dosing rule?

criteria.false: It was taken fewer than 11 or more than 13 hours of real elapsed time after the previous dose.
criteria.true: It was taken 11 to 13 hours of real elapsed time after the previous dose.
